correctness.rationale: For all 0<r,v,theta<1, direct joint event probabilities P(A=B=t)=v(ab)^t and P(A=t,B=u)=r(1-v)(1-(1-r)(1-v))((1-r)(1-v))^(u-1) for t<u factor into independent A and L=B-A. Geometric sums give Var(A)=ab/d^2 and E L=rb/d^2. Random orientation gives exact covariance Var(A)-theta(1-theta)(E L)^2. Reparameterizing by tie probability pi=v/(r+(1-r)v) reduces sign to a-c(1-pi)(1-a*pi), with strictly increasing sign bracket on 0<pi<1; all endpoint and equality cases are resolved. Independent finite PMF enumeration reproduced six examples and the critical root but is not relied on for the infinite claim.

value.rationale: The 2026 source prominently studies conditional PQD and the adjustable fraction of tied outcomes. The classification shows that mixing over the unobserved first-failure orientation can reverse unconditional covariance, and characterizes precisely when and at what tie mass this happens throughout the parameter domain. A sharp sign transition with an observable tie-rate calibration criterion is a motivated reliability dependence boundary beyond a numeric example or routine single-parameter substitution.
